constraints.statement: Bind one or more contracts as data source and action target. Derive State from projections without UX redeclaration of asset shape. Product-truth-changing Msg variants map one-to-one to action-registry entries or wrap them through a documented projection with no hidden semantic change. UX-local Msg variants serve only view-local concerns such as open/closed, sorting and filter input. Selection emits Context or equivalent updates consistent with the selection contract. Writes use the action registry, never direct file/service calls. Absence of an admitted contract blocks product-truth-changing actions.

The stated provenance of this prompt claim is an rc.2 compression, not an rc.2 body; prompt construction is assigned to ACTIVATION §2.

constraints.statement: In graph execution the runtime owns continuation and the product is a cooperative bounded-step subsystem. The UX view owns no state continuation: declared Msg actions flow through the reducer; the view cannot independently choose next state, chain updates without separate Msg values or hide inter-event state. Any multi-step local machine belongs in reducer State with explicit phase messages and a pure phase projection. Inability to replay behavior from its Msg log against empty State indicates leaked continuation.

unless an

constraints.statement: Every surface carries at least one executable proof per product-meaningful interaction family before closure. Include initial State, ordered Msg log, expected final State, expected ordered Cmd values, both success/failure Msg returns and deterministic time, randomness, IDs and external payloads. Correctness depending on unrepresented DOM state; mutable refs, modules, closures, timers or effect-handler memory; network/file results bypassing typed Msg; or view-local state affecting product behavior after unmount or replay fails the proof.

exceptions: Out-of-render mutation is excepted from the stated §6 violation only when part of the declared effect membrane, such as a design-named platform handle for imperative interop.

violates §6 unless the mutation is part of the declared effect membrane,
for example a platform handle for imperative interop already named in the
design module

constraints.statement: Accept typed state/props/context, return a typed tree, declare consumed inputs, capture no mutable state across renders, read no undeclared sources and have no side effects in the body. Dependence on out-of-render mutation, including an effect-written ref read during render, violates the stated membrane rule subject to its recorded exception.
constraints.uncertainty: The full §6 effect-membrane law is outside the supplied sections.

constraints.statement: Import shared back-end shapes rather than redeclaring or shadowing them. Runtime validation is mandatory at every untrusted or out-of-process seam, including HTTP/RPC, MCP, files, websocket/event streams, agent/worker outputs, and URL/storage/clipboard/browser payloads. One typed-schema definition supplies both compile-time types and runtime validators; compile-time TypeScript alone is insufficient. This upgrades the cited DESIGN_MODULE ingress preference to an obligation at these seams.

constraints.statement: Local compliance proof may be deferred as cost optimization without weakening the process model. If non-escrowable work appears, record the finding and exit by standalone repricing or sprint supersession; UX still cannot become a hidden constructive carrier. The sprint should close when further iteration is more expensive or less trustworthy than review. Valid triggers include timebox expiry, too many changed states for casual review, obsolete screenshots/walkthrough evidence, interaction changes beyond polish, and reviewer uncertainty requiring reconciliation.

constraints.statement: Forensically review every changed screen, state and product-meaningful interaction against cited authority. Each finding receives accepted, local_paydown, design_reframe, requirement_reprice, product_reprice or remove. Accepted means compliance with this profile and cited design; local_paydown means local UX debt in a paydown ticket. Unclassified carrier gaps, hidden continuation or authority drift forbid sprint closure. Product-surface closure still requires replay proofs and accessibility obligations; iteration can defer but cannot erase them.

constraints.statement: replay_passes → satisfied when deterministic replay reproduces expected final State and ordered Cmds with no forbidden correctness dependency; replay_fails → falsified for divergence or such dependency, naming it. closure_obligations_met → satisfied when every meaningful interaction family has proof and accessibility declarations are carried, or an exemption covers the obligation; closure_unproven → falsified for an uncovered missing proof/declaration, naming it. carrier_admitted → satisfied when every truth-changing message/action maps to an admitted carrier and binds an AssetSurface where published, otherwise the design-named equivalent contract; carrier_missing → falsified for an action without admitted carrier/typed contract, naming it.

constraints.statement: When no refined value applies, use indeterminate for evidence unable to decide, naming needed evidence; out_of_frame for undeclared required relation/capability; invalid_basis for other unsupported subject/basis. Ambiguity applies the stricter fixed interpretation and never alone yields compliant; if a depended-on term is undefined and no stricter interpretation is fixed, return out_of_frame naming term and owner. New clauses are escrow-term binding, result refinements and foundation-family table. constraints.statement: The profile imports FOUNDATIONS, ACTIVATION, EVALUATION, IDENTITY, SPEC_METHOD, PRODUCT_DEFINITION, RELEASE and TICKETS under PROFILES §1 without redefining their objects. Object/Authority/Basis and lineage belong to FOUNDATIONS, scoped identity to IDENTITY, cross-context relations/carrier to PRODUCT_DEFINITION §5, core results to FOUNDATIONS §4, step refinements to ACTIVATION §3, and statistical Markov boundary to a FOUNDATIONS §5 hypothesis. ODD is the graph-execution profile. Each clause names its P0–P6 principle. Indicative text carries predecessor must-force; should/may/preferred/optional/mandatory/minimum/least/usually/sufficient/lawful retain their distinctions. rc.2 routes are provenance only, not required predecessor re-entry.
constraints.uncertainty: Imported definitions beyond the local descriptions are unavailable.

grounding.quote:
World-model work has two constitutional intents: build published domain
artifacts; and compose those artifacts into higher-order world models

constraints.statement: Building published domain artifacts and composing them into higher-order models define the two constitutional intents. Query, traversal and serving are important delivery concerns but do not define this identity; a later dedicated plane does not change the two intents.

grounding.quote:
If these claims do not hold, the work is not genuinely
world-model-driven

constraints.statement: Observe before standardising and comprehend enacted semantics before schemas. Treat domains as bounded function, data as contextual evidence, and recover experts' implicit objects/boundaries/states/transitions/treatments/reference artifacts. Materialise governed conceptual understanding rather than detached metadata. Ground probabilistic cross-domain reasoning first; fully qualify names before deeper transformation. Model change as treatment/covariance/adjoint interpretation. Publish immutable explicitly superseded cuts; compose without erasing local authority. Keep probabilistic correspondence in governed epistemic overlays and compile accepted meaning for volume. Projections remain derived conveniences; generation follows descriptive grounding. Failure of these commitments means the work is not world-model-driven.

conditions: World-model work is adopted under this profile.

grounding.quote:
- I4: some builders work over a representation space in which identity is
  a geometric direction.

constraints.statement: Instance assumptions are I1 sovereign enacted source truth with no replacement; I2 records lack self-contained meaning while people already commit to objects; I3 probabilistic correspondence proposals and deterministic-volume delivery; I4 some representation spaces express identity direction. The table distinguishes independent P1/P2/P3/P4a/P6, P4b derived from P0/P2 with non-reacquirable step facts, P5 derived from P0/P6 with open-world premise, and recovered P0. Its eleven consequence families concern semantic truth; identity-bearing discriminated cuts; append-only evidence/publication; treatment/projection; owned imports/specialisation; candidate standing; space-bound verified directions; control/data split; bounded saturation/federated composition; practical wedge; and predicate-specific results. Profile choices include intents, manifesto, evidence order, eight cut surfaces/three values, initial Git lane, treatment fields/API-before-schema preference, Builder specialisation, candidate vocabulary/refinements/research pin, direction methods/verification/publication/storage choices, plane split, preferred mesh, wedge and seven results. Builder projects choose discrimination techniques; consumers choose carriers/layouts/schemas/storage; external owners retain taxonomy, treatment licensing/adequacy and statistical hypothesis.
constraints.uncertainty: This preserves the table's attributed derivation and choice distinction, without proving its deductions.

conditions: A listed consumer applies a foundation-map rule.

grounding.quote:
Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
not

constraints.statement: Consumers do not expand owning-section decisions. The table's application routes cover: semantic truth → evidence gathering/materialisation/planes; entity cuts → primary units/refinements/status/discovery/sparse publication/materialisation/geometric verification/results; ledgers → immutable Markov cuts/overlay supersession; treatments → relate/project stages; lineage → Builder unit; candidate status → CONFORMANCE discriminator 12/FOUNDATIONS hypothesis/effective blanket/Markov theory/verification/gate results; overlay construction → refinements/units/geometric materialisation/direction-publication-storage-null-peer results; saturation/composition → refinements/flow/admissibility/saturation results. Plane split, wedge and result rows identify no separate rule consumer. ODD/UX defer semantics; GLOSSARY locates but decides nothing; output and source-disposition inventories decide nothing. The uncited opening/units/output sections apply existing consequences rather than supply additional table derivations.
constraints.uncertainty: Several consumer loci and all external consumer bodies are absent; connectivity does not establish new normative dependencies.

grounding.quote:
The two
compose; they do not compete

constraints.statement: SPEC_METHOD owns general process constitution; WORLD_MODEL refines it for observation and bounded artifact publication and is primary within urn:stdo:bounded-context:world-model under the selected complete basis. Products may declare narrower owned contexts without changing this one by proximity. Where a product is both graph-native and world-model-driven, graph execution governs execution shape, traversal and product-authoring structure, while WORLD_MODEL governs semantics, publication and composition.

conditions: The selected complete method basis supports the declared import from recursive-product-taxonomy into world-model.

grounding.quote:
the relation expands applicability into the target context and
mints no alias or new semantic owner

constraints.statement: Exactly the four listed URNs are imported unchanged; source and target references use the same identity, retain FOUNDATIONS ownership and expand applicability only. No same-spelled other concept is imported, no alias is minted and GLOSSARY only locates meanings. Changes to either context, a cited concept or taxonomy clause, or the selected basis invalidate the import until reevaluation.

conditions: World-model construction under this profile on a selected complete release containing both source and target clauses.

grounding.quote:
a change to either concept or context, the
  selected method basis, the builder configuration relation, or the
  governed scope invalidates the translation until the owning authorities
  reevaluate it

constraints.statement: The relation is source-to-target specialisation only: no inverse, equivalence, unchanged import, alias or claim that every Source Project is a Builder Project. Preserve mutable next-release workspace meaning and distinction from Release Cut/Product/Install/Artifact, narrowing to configured builder inputs/settings/publication lane. Exclude general projects outside that configuration; installed Product or Install cannot substitute for Builder Project. FOUNDATIONS retains source ownership and this profile owns only the target. The clause is the normative relation carrier; changes to concepts, contexts, basis, configuration relation or scope invalidate it until owner reevaluation.

grounding.quote:
A world model is not a replacement system of record; a central monolith
that erases local semantics; a generic catalog entry; a copied data
warehouse; or a schema registry pretending to be comprehension

constraints.statement: A world model should expose real objects in context, coherent boundaries, material states/transitions, supporting evidence, governing classifications, adjacent reinterpretations, covariance and preserved/changed/aggregated/delayed/lost meaning. It cannot be a replacement record system, semantics-erasing monolith, generic catalog entry, copied warehouse or schema registry masquerading as comprehension.

grounding.quote:
The profile should produce world models that are bounded, inspectable,
challengeable, evidence-backed, versioned, composable,
projection-capable and machine-reasonable

constraints.statement: Models should be bounded, inspectable, challengeable, evidence-backed, versioned, composable, projection-capable and machine-reasonable. Working adoption should make answerable the record's object, defining boundary, supporting evidence, locally authoritative source, downstream meaning-changing treatment, relation of differently treated objects, contemporaneous value/classification list, and why a downstream figure is or is not explainable upstream.

grounding.quote:
Those surfaces may be
important; they do not create a second truth surface

constraints.statement: The published semantic layer alone is constitutional semantic truth: domain artifacts, fragments, entity cuts, explicit treatments/covariance/adjoints/temporal references and models composed by reference. Epistemic overlays, query planes, mapping reports and compiled execution artifacts remain downstream/supporting, however important; this does not displace source-system operational sovereignty.

grounding.quote:
The profile therefore never depends on code
availability as a prerequisite for comprehension

constraints.statement: Work from strongest available explanation. Preferred order is realised behavior plus emitted records/events; available code/rules/configuration; interfaces/schemas; large-scale observation; documentation/catalogs/operator testimony. Code is high fidelity when available, but realised behavior is broader for proprietary, partially visible or output-intelligible systems. Code availability is never a prerequisite.

exceptions: These working refinements are not entity-cut admissibility conditions.

grounding.quote:
They constrain the construct and overlays built on it. They are not
admissibility conditions for entity cuts, which §9 governs

constraints.statement: Adopt four pinned candidate-evidence readings, not formal closure: (1) exp 17 supports geometric identity-axis boundaries; column membership leaks under bypass and identity survival under treatment is the test; (2) every fixed attribute basis senses/fragments identity, so overlays expose the axis rather than only a profile and schemas are evidence, not ontology; (3) exps 15/16 make semantic invariant identity, not core size, diagnostic—sparse invariant objects can be lawful while rich clusters without contextual invariance are not; (4) exp 18 treats identity as DC/mean offset from a null peer rather than dominant variance, excluding principal-component/maximum-variance identity constructions. The pinned companion fixes the adopted reading despite later recuts.
constraints.uncertainty: The empirical basis is reported by the source but not independently present.

grounding.quote:
The gate stands
where it is; it has not been met and is not relocated to accommodate the
negative result

constraints.statement: The construct is load-bearing working vocabulary at candidate standing. Adoption need not await complete empirical research; formally dependent commitments remain revisable working commitments. Promotion requires direction-native conditional independence: given identity projection, residual variation in remaining components should be target-independent under plausible treatments. Both the reported test and multilayer successor failed their predicates; the gate remains unchanged. Construct and overlays inherit candidate standing, not certified blanket status. Entity cuts instead stand on their own admissibility; candidates not meeting it remain candidates, published cuts do not inherit Markov candidate status. Tooling should default to candidate-class publication and reserve formally closed kinds for real gate-backed cuts.

conditions: A Markov object is read as a candidate identity-bearing cut.

grounding.quote:
This profile does not make the empirical Markov-object program a
prerequisite for all design work.

constraints.statement: Good software boundary design should prefer the smallest lawful carrier set preserving real authority; subordinate payloads unless independently authoritative; resistance to promotion of sensed fragments into unnecessary peer objects; and strongly typed semantic boundaries rather than fuzzy, reconstructive or controller-owned cuts. This is one theoretical framing, not an empirical prerequisite for design. DESIGN_MODULE owns engineering law valid outside world-model products.
constraints.uncertainty: The cited DESIGN_MODULE theoretical framing is not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Every treatment declares preserved structure,
changed meaning, loss, surplus and ambiguity

constraints.statement: Source systems retain operational truth; data is constrained-function evidence and invalid as isolated meaning. World models externalise experts' implicit understanding. Every cross-domain treatment declares preserved structure, changed meaning, loss, surplus and ambiguity; ACTIVATION refinement supplies preservation/licensing law, and changed meaning requires an approximate step with adequacy relation. Fully qualified naming is mandatory under scoped identity. Changing value lists/classifications are governed temporal artifacts. API/schema contracts are useful projections, not highest semantic authority. Canonical cuts should stay semantic and bounded; probability belongs to uncertainty/ranking/anomaly/alignment overlays, not object identity. Accepted treatments, artifacts and deterministic execution remain distinct from probabilistic overlays.
constraints.uncertainty: Treatment licensing and adequacy definitions are imported from an unsupplied section.

exceptions: Align, compile and serve/query are optional stages under their stated delivery conditions.

grounding.quote:
The ledger is append-only: new understanding is recorded as new
   qualified claims and later object cuts, not by mutating prior accepted
   entries in place.

constraints.statement: Observe strongest available sources; tracing should support concrete source-span/field/locator/code-path/record re-entry. Extract reviewable inventories and object/event/lifecycle/treatment/authority candidates plus ambiguities, not yet a world model. Assurance should expose claim, observed/derived/interpreted/composed status, supporting surfaces, aspect-specific authority and gaps. Append accepted qualified claims without mutating earlier entries. Bound by function/authority/state/adjacency, rejecting schema-first or vocabulary-cluster modelling. Materialise bounded, distinguishable evidence-backed cuts; sparse publication is lawful. Relate with treatments/covariance/adjoints/temporal references. Publish immutable cuts, with Git/filesystem sufficient at low volume. Compose recursively, inspectably and boundedly without erasing authority. Optional alignment produces epistemic, not yet semantic-truth outputs. Project tables/schema/API/event contracts, mapping documents, transform specifications/covariant transforms/tests/app scaffolds as applicable. Optional real-execution compilation is governed by accepted understanding; scale should use deterministic artifacts rather than per-row inference. Optional serving requires justified delivery needs and may remain filesystem-first or move to a query plane.

exceptions: Outside a declared geometric representation space the law is discharged semantically under entity-cut construction.

grounding.quote:
Outside such a space the same law is
discharged semantically under §9

constraints.statement: Every published entity cut is prompt-sufficient for reasoning; at minimum it should visibly expose its eight semantic surfaces. Explicit blanket means the boundary where identity survives adjacent-domain reinterpretation, not member-column enumeration. Schemas evidence identity rather than constitute it; the boundary test is interventional. Where a representation space exists the boundary is a low-rank identity-preserving projection and an overlay should expose both distributed evidence and identity-recovering projection.

grounding.quote:
No object attribute
should exist without ledger support; no ledger entry should exist without
assurance; no assurance should exist without traceable source

constraints.statement: Materialised cuts are builder artifacts and canonical object-level semantic truth, not raw source-emitted objects or mutable operational truth. Domain artifacts should be versioned and explicitly superseded. The chain is source → tracing → assurance → attribute ledger → entity cut. A cut immutably selects one bounded identity/boundary and accompanies evidence plus acceptance basis; one ledger state may support many identity/boundary/context selections, and records of selection do not equate ledger and cut. Every accepted attribute should be recoverable through its cut, ledger entries, assurance and traced source; no unsupported link should exist. Geometric selections additionally invoke overlay construction.

grounding.quote:
Both should remain append-only and
replayable

constraints.statement: Published truth should be immutable per cut, diff-reviewable, evidence-traceable and explicitly superseded rather than overwritten. Initial filesystem/Git publication is sufficient; a later database is a query complement, not publication authority. Publication ledger and attribute ledger remain distinct and both should be append-only and replayable; independent supplied flow/cut laws impose explicit immutability and append-only obligations.

grounding.quote:
The profile does not assume one source per attribute; it
assumes one lawful claim record per accepted attribute fact

constraints.statement: The ledger is the immediate semantic source of cuts. Each entry should be fully qualified and may contain values/quantities, rules, classifications, topology/relations, provenance/authority and effective/observed/publication coordinates. One or more evidence sources may support it, such as policy documents, code invariants/derivations and observed data. The cardinality requirement is one lawful claim record per accepted attribute fact, not one source per attribute.

grounding.quote:
Entities are recovered, not invented. A builder project constructs an
entity cut by trawling authoritative source surfaces for the boundaries
the operating model already commits to, then qualifying them into
published truth

constraints.statement: Construct cuts by recovering already-committed operating-model boundaries from authoritative source surfaces and qualifying them; builders do not invent institutional entities. Looser starting candidates converge to entity cuts or are explicitly left as non-object artifacts such as treatments, covariance edges or temporal references.

grounding.quote:
"Explicit" admits three lawful values on every surface: a stated value,
stated absence, or stated non-applicability with its reason.

constraints.statement: The whole constitutional test is eight explicit, traceable surfaces—identity, boundary, authority, state, evidence, treatment, covariance, ambiguity—discriminated from plausible alternatives at evidence altitude proportional to the claim. It prescribes what holds, not a mandatory technique. Every surface admits a stated value, stated absence, or reasoned non-applicability; absence of adjacent treatment must not provoke invented treatment. Sparse, unique, historical, single-context, inaccessible or regulated entities remain publishable when the test holds and residual ambiguity is declared. Missing comparison populations, repeated contexts or intervention permission are stated evidence-altitude bounds, not publication bans.

grounding.quote: Boundary is interventional in character, not structural.

constraints.statement: State why this boundary rather than a nearby one treated differently; stronger claims require stronger discrimination. Semantic adjoint round-trip corresponds to geometric boundary discrimination. Where intervention is possible, interventional evidence discriminates more strongly than declarations and the cut should state its evidence kind. A field-set-only boundary is a weaker claim than specified identity-preserving reinterpretations and should be read accordingly.

conditions: An entity cut is published.

grounding.quote:
Cuts are immutable: revising
identity or boundary produces a new cut that supersedes the prior one

constraints.statement: Publish all eight admissibility surfaces visibly and traceably with their lawful explicit values and record the discrimination basis. Identity/boundary revision creates a new superseding immutable cut. Consumer storage form is free only while all required surfaces survive.

conditions: The builder operates in a declared representation space where identity is geometric.
exceptions: This specialisation is not required for ordinary institutional recovery.

grounding.quote:
directions computed in
different spaces do not compose

constraints.statement: Use the directional interventional procedure as both construction steps and minimum stored publication structure. Include the representation space in the overlay; directions are uninterpretable without it and cannot compose across different spaces.

conditions: The geometric overlay construction law applies.

grounding.quote:
paired ledger entries covering `(candidate, context)` and
  `(null, context)`, so identity-carrying signal can be separated from
  context-carrying signal.

constraints.statement: Collect candidate ledger evidence across multiple instantiated contexts and at least one identity-lacking structurally similar null peer in the same contexts; pair candidate/context and null/context entries to separate identity from context signal. Entries remain distributed raw evidence and are not the object.

conditions: A candidate identity direction is evaluated for acceptance/publication.

grounding.quote:
Passing this battery establishes that a direction is verified for
publication under this profile; it does not establish a formally closed
Markov blanket

constraints.statement: Accept only if projection preserves identity under held-out treatments and at least one acceptable verification is recorded: α-sweep x − α·d showing expected identity shift and saturation on held-out contexts; transplant x + α·d into null peers showing acquisition; or overwriting attributes outside projection support while identity survives. No acceptable verification leaves a candidate, not an accepted overlay; publishing it violates Representation law. Its entity cut remains lawful without the overlay. Verification for publication is distinct from formally closed conditional independence, which the reported empirical program did not establish.

conditions: Candidates appear in multiple contexts.

grounding.quote:
decompose the attribute
evidence into an invariant core, the attributes whose contribution to the
identity direction is stable across ≥ N of N contexts, and a context
coat

constraints.statement: Decompose evidence into the all-N-context stable identity-contribution core and context-selected treatment coat. Keep both as evidence and treat coat/core ratio as characterization, not quality.
constraints.uncertainty: N and the stability criterion are not operationally specified in the supplied text.

conditions: Before publication under the Markov-object overlay construction law.

grounding.quote:
Failure on the uniqueness and transfer tests means the cluster is not yet
a lawful Markov object

constraints.statement: Compare accepted candidates with null peers to distinguish object from incidental cluster. Similar core-size ranges are expected and acceptable, not diagnostic. Identity-loaded core attributes should be unique among peers and identity transfer should be cleaner than a random diagonal. The result mapping makes either uniqueness or transfer failure not_yet_lawful, even with internally consistent invariants.
constraints.uncertainty: The source supplies no quantitative uniqueness/clean-transfer threshold.

conditions: An overlay is published.
exceptions: The effective α coordinate is included where applicable.

grounding.quote:
A change of representation space changes every direction expressed in it
and is therefore a supersession even when no ledger entry changed. Prior
overlays are never mutated in place

constraints.statement: Expose at minimum declared/versioned space and attribute basis; identity projection/vector or equivalent; ledger-traced core/coat evidence; verification treatments/outcomes/held-out contexts; identity-preserving projection support; null peers tested and acceptance/rejection; and applicable α. Overlays are immutable projections. Revised direction due to new contexts/evidence/refit creates a superseding overlay; a space change itself supersedes every expressed direction even without ledger changes.

conditions: An overlay is stored.
exceptions: The supersession record names a predecessor if any.

grounding.quote:
A storage layout that loses any of these surfaces is not a lawful
Markov-object storage layout.

constraints.statement: Store a package attached to its entity cut, not merely a table row or membership list: space/version; direction/projection support; distributed ledger evidence pointers; treatment/context/outcome verification trace; acceptance provenance/authority and assurance; and supersession record. Loss of any surface is unlawful. Downstream query/projection conveniences cannot substitute for this package.

grounding.quote:
Sparse first
publication remains lawful (§9 Admissibility); silent unsupported
attribute creation does not

constraints.statement: Builders may iterate a bounded source-object set until judged sufficiently saturated: materially important attributes have traceable support, remaining gaps are explicit ambiguities, and the cut is stable enough to publish and supersede later. Sparse first publication remains lawful; silent unsupported attributes do not.
constraints.uncertainty: Sufficient importance and publication stability are bounded judgments, not numerical thresholds supplied here.

grounding.quote:
profile-level mesh law should be ratified only
once the reusable node and edge model is stable

constraints.statement: Build local published artifacts/cuts before stitching, not a central monolith first. Composition preserves fragment authority, bounded-context meaning, treatment semantics, declared loss and ambiguity; higher-order models do not erase constituents. A federated mesh is preferred over flattening. Developing topology may stay product-local; profile mesh law should await stable reusable nodes/edges.

grounding.quote:
the preferred structural order is
`world model -> API contract -> schema contract`.

constraints.statement: The semantic kernel remains primary. All projections should trace to governing objects, evidence, treatments, covariance, adjoints and applicable temporal references. Tables/schemas/APIs/mapping documents/covariant transforms publish the same kernel. World model → API contract → schema contract is preferred because APIs usually carry more business semantics. Query/traversal may be first-class delivery without becoming constitutional core.

grounding.quote:
They should not be the
row-by-row execution engine for large-scale data movement when the
semantic understanding has already been accepted and can be compiled

constraints.statement: Semantic artifacts carry truth, epistemic overlays probabilistic correspondence/uncertainty, compiled artifacts deterministic runtime behavior. LLMs and other probabilistic systems primarily belong on the control plane and should aid comprehension, candidate alignment, ambiguity reduction and ranking. Once accepted meaning can be compiled, they should not drive large-scale movement row by row. The plane split introduces no second semantic truth.

grounding.quote:
Where the line is mature enough, the proof should
also show that accepted semantic understanding can be compiled into
deterministic executable pipelines without losing the traceability and
challengeability of the governing world model

constraints.statement: Adoption should not wait to win standardisation. The preferred five-step wedge is incremental capture, not immediate centralized convergence. Its practical proof is one semantic substrate producing both expected legacy artifacts and richer covariant outputs. Mature lines should additionally demonstrate deterministic compilation preserving traceability and challengeability.

grounding.quote:
Use
normative application specs where the problem is primarily user
interaction, workflow choice, non-domain behaviour, or operational policy
beyond the domain semantics themselves.

constraints.statement: Preferred chain: world model → epistemic correspondence overlay → deterministic compiled artifacts → implementation. Simpler lines may use world model → application projections → implementation. Use normative application specifications for primarily user interaction, workflow choice, non-domain behavior or extra-domain operational policy; use world-model semantics where software mainly interfaces with stable domain reality. A sufficiently well-formed model can project large application portions without semantic re-authoring.

conditions: The profile is working.
exceptions: Inspectable Markov overlays occur where representation space is selected; compiled execution artifacts occur where real volume requires them.

grounding.quote: - a basis for AI reasoning over real institutional meaning.

constraints.statement: Expected outputs are durable published artifacts, composed models, primary entity cuts, applicable inspectable Markov overlays, explicit treatment/covariance semantics, grounded epistemic correspondence overlays, temporal references, familiar projections, volume-appropriate deterministic artifacts and a basis for AI reasoning over institutional meaning. This is an output description, not a returned evaluation result.

grounding.quote:
SPEC_METHOD, the constitutional specification
method; RELEASE, the method for publishing immutable cuts and promoting
version-line selectors for installed consumer bases; TICKETS, the method
for turning discovery into bounded execution work

constraints.statement: SPEC_METHOD supplies constitutional specification method, RELEASE immutable-cut publication and installed-base version-selector promotion, and TICKETS bounded discovery work. The pinned empirical companion reports geometric-reading evidence from experiment 08 onward and failed promotion predicates in experiment 20 and its multilayer successor. It is research evidence, not constitutional authority; later research revisions do not amend the profile.
constraints.uncertainty: Companion content is not supplied for direct examination.

grounding.quote: | cut admissibility | `discrimination_undecided` | indeterminate | no counterexample of `cut_inadmissible` is found, and the admissible evidence cannot decide the discrimination the cut itself claims at its stated altitude; the value names the evidence that would decide |

constraints.statement: Cut predicate: all eight surfaces explicit, traceable and proportionally discriminated. cut_admissible → satisfied for lawful surface values including reasoned non-applicability and declared sparse evidence bounds/residual ambiguity; cut_inadmissible → falsified for a missing lawful value, untraceability or evidence of an undiscriminated plausible alternative, naming it; discrimination_undecided → indeterminate only with no counterexample and evidence unable to decide the cut's own altitude-specific claim, naming needed evidence. Direction predicate: admissible extraction, held-out identity preservation and recorded acceptable verification. direction_verified → satisfied requires admissible extraction in declared space, at least one acceptable recorded verification and no recorded identity loss; extraction_inadmissible → falsified for PCA/maximum variance regardless of verification; verification_failed → falsified for admissible extraction with recorded identity loss; verification_inconclusive → indeterminate for admissible extraction in declared space with a run deciding neither preservation nor loss, naming deciding treatment/verification; representation_space_invalid → invalid_basis only absent extraction/verification counterexamples, where no space is declared or cross-space directions are composed.

grounding.quote: | promotion gate | `gate_not_met` | falsified | the run does not meet the test's predicate; it is the counterexample for that run only, and the construct's standing is unchanged |

constraints.statement: Publication predicate is recorded acceptable direction verification: published_verified → satisfied; published_unverified → falsified for publishing without it. Storage predicate is retention of six package surfaces: storage_retained → satisfied; storage_lossy → falsified naming the lost surface. Null-peer predicate is both uniqueness and cleaner-than-random transfer: null_peer_discriminated → satisfied; not_yet_lawful → falsified if either fails, naming it. Gate predicate belongs to a particular conditional-independence run: gate_met → satisfied; gate_not_met → falsified for that run only without changing construct standing. Saturation predicate is supported material attributes, explicit remaining ambiguity and publication-stable cut: saturated → satisfied carrying gaps as residuals; not_saturated → falsified naming a failed condition such as unsupported attribute or silent gap.

exceptions: The no-result rule for unrun verification applies only when neither extraction_inadmissible nor representation_space_invalid grounds hold.

grounding.quote:
a candidate direction whose
verification has not been run has no result for direction acceptance

constraints.statement: When no refined value applies, core indeterminate names deciding evidence unavailable to the evaluation; out_of_frame names an undeclared needed relation/capability; invalid_basis covers other unsupported subjects/bases. Unrun verification is no direction-acceptance result at all, never indeterminate or another core value; direction stays candidate. In conjunctions it is a planned assessment without closed result if planned, otherwise uncovered coverage. A construction step stopped without needed verification ends incomplete for construction's candidate-available predicate and retains verification as a work-state residual; publication remains published_unverified. Lawful stated absence/non-applicability are surface values, not non-satisfied results. Candidate/established are construct standings; candidate-class/formally closed are publication kinds, not results. Failed gate runs do not falsify the construct.
constraints.uncertainty: External core conjunction and construction mappings are referenced but not independently supplied.
